items.title: Nova AI
items.description: Multimodal Emotional Intelligence System combining facial expression recognition, vocal tone analysis, and text into a unified emotional context vector. Psychological Analysis SLM layer generates session-level well-being reports with stress profiling. Living memory architecture for session continuity with adaptive tone-shifting; React 19 + Vite frontend with privacy-first local data storage.

items.title: ExamGuard Pro
items.description: AI-powered real-time proctoring with multi-modal analysis: MediaPipe face detection, gaze tracking, YOLOv8 device detection, and Tesseract OCR for forbidden-content screening. Dynamic weighted risk scoring with automated PDF reports. Four-layer cheat-resistance architecture: Chrome Manifest V3 extension, FastAPI backend, Supabase real-time DB, and JWT-secured multi-agent AI pipeline with WebSocket live dashboard.

items.title: StudyBuddy Pro
items.description: Adaptive AI-powered learning suite with offline-capable smart quiz and flashcard generation from student notes using local NLP algorithms. Spaced repetition engine adjusts difficulty in real-time. Gamified productivity layer: Pomodoro timer with XP/coin rewards, daily streak tracking, and a configurable task manager; full-stack local-first architecture with JWT auth and SQLite.

items.title: Personal Portfolio
items.description: Interactive developer portfolio with 3D graphics (Three.js + React Three Fiber), particle animations (tsParticles), and smooth transitions (Framer Motion). Sections covering projects, skills, achievements, and a blog; styled with Styled Components and built in React + TypeScript.

items.title: RobinHood Tax System
items.description: Comprehensive tax compliance system with automated calculations, taxpayer management, multi-type notice generation, and CLI tools. Implements India's progressive tax system with Flask and MySQL.

items.title: MatsyaN - Fish Recognition
items.description: Intelligent fish species recognition and analysis system using deep learning and Gradio. Classifies fish species from images with CNNs, providing detailed species information and habitat data.
